name: Resizable Panels
summary: Resizable Panels. A composable spatial primitive that keeps product layouts predictable across containers.

lifecycle.compatibility: Early contract that may change in a pre-1.0 minor release.
lifecycle.rationale: The component is experimental while nested layouts, persistence ownership, touch behavior, and cross-browser accessibility evidence are incubated.
knownLimitations: Consumers own persistence and must reconcile stored size with changed minimum and maximum bounds.
Nested panels and touch resizing require explicit product testing before production adoption.
promotionCriteria: Public API, defaults, aliases and entrypoint ownership are reviewed.
SSR/hydration, keyboard, accessibility and visual evidence are linked.
Runtime scale limits and consumer testing contract are documented.
Migration impact is classified before lifecycle promotion.

api.name: orientation
api.description: Sets the panel flow axis: horizontal follows inline, vertical follows block.

api.name: sizes
api.description: Controlled sizes state with a matching Angular model-change output.

api.name: step
api.description: Sets the keyboard resize increment in percentage points, with a 0.25 minimum.

api.name: disabled
api.description: Prevents user interaction and participates in the disabled-state contract.

api.name: resizeEnd
api.description: Notifies the consumer after the resize end interaction completes.

keyboard: Arrow keys adjust the focused separator by the configured step and respect orientation and RTL.
Home and End move to the minimum and maximum allowed size.
Enter or Space toggles the documented collapsed size when collapse is enabled.
notes: The handle exposes separator orientation, value minimum, maximum, current value, and disabled state.
The separator has an explicit localized accessible name.
Pointer and keyboard changes use the same clamped size model.
KERN avoids ambient browser globals in reusable runtime infrastructure.
Validate the consuming SSR/hydration route, locale, ids and overlay host.

examples.title: Controlled resizable workspace

guidance.useWhen: Use Resizable Panels when adjacent workspace regions need a persisted user-adjustable size within explicit minimum and maximum bounds.
guidance.avoidWhen: Use Split Layout when regions should follow responsive rules without direct manipulation.

commonMistakes: Importing from an undeclared family path or a source implementation file.
Loading only tokens.css instead of the complete styles/kern.css component bundle.
Assuming the documentation SSR build replaces validation of the consuming application.
checklist: Import the symbol from its documented owner entrypoint; do not use a deep source import.
Load @kern-ui/angular/styles/kern.css exactly once in the application's global styles.
Provide every required input and keep collection identities stable across updates.
Verify keyboard, focus, visible labels, invalid state, long text, RTL and 200% zoom.
Test the consuming SSR/hydration route when server rendering is enabled.
Use @kern-ui/angular/testing harnesses when a component-specific harness is available.
